When_a_new_email_arrives_in_the_HR_share.description: Concurrency is 1 so two replies on the same thread can never race into duplicate tickets.

Compose_Email.description: Normalised view of the incoming email used by every later step.

Compose_Body_Text.description: Plain text, truncated to keep prompt cost predictable.

Filter_ignored_senders.description: Sender address contains a pattern such as noreply / mailer-daemon / a vendor newsletter domain.

Filter_ignored_subjects.description: Out-of-office, NDRs, meeting responses, read receipts.

Compose_Ticket_Reference.inputs: @if(contains(outputs('Compose_Email')?['subject'], concat('[', variables('Settings')?['ticketPrefix'])), substring(outputs('Compose_Email')?['subject'], add(indexOf(outputs('Compose_Email')?['subject'], concat('[', variables('Settings')?['ticketPrefix'])), 1), min(add(length(variables('Settings')?['ticketPrefix']), 6), sub(length(outputs('Compose_Email')?['subject']), add(indexOf(outputs('Compose_Email')?['subject'], concat('[', variables('Settings')?['ticketPrefix'])), 1)))), '')
Compose_Ticket_Reference.description: Extracts a ticket number such as HR-000123 from a subject line like 'RE: Payroll question [HR-000123]'.

parameters.$filter: (ConversationId eq '@{outputs('Compose_Email')?['conversationId']}'@{if(empty(outputs('Compose_Ticket_Reference')), '', concat(' or TicketNumber eq ''', outputs('Compose_Ticket_Reference'), ''''))}) and Status ne 'Closed'

Get_existing_open_ticket.description: Is this email part of a conversation that already has an open ticket? (Index the ConversationId and TicketNumber columns.)

Compose_Template_Parts.description: Video technique: split the plain-text body on the pipe character. Padding guarantees indexes 0-7 always exist.

Compose_Is_Standard_Template.description: True when the subject has the template keyword AND the body follows assets/hr-request-email-template.txt.

inputs.name: Reason
inputs.value: @if(equals(variables('Route'), 'classify'), '', if(equals(outputs('Compose_Email')?['fromLower'], toLower(parameters('HR Shared Mailbox (hrt_SharedMailbox)'))), 'Rule: sent by the shared mailbox itself', if(greater(length(body('Filter_ignored_senders')), 0), concat('Rule: ignored sender pattern ', first(body('Filter_ignored_senders'))), if(greater(length(body('Filter_ignored_subjects')), 0), concat('Rule: ignored subject prefix ', first(body('Filter_ignored_subjects'))), concat('Rule: reply on existing ticket ', first(outputs('Get_existing_open_ticket')?['body/value'])?['TicketNumber'])))))

Set_AI_-_from_template.description: Field values sit at the odd indexes, exactly like the video's split(...)[1], [3], [5], [7]. Invalid category/priority values are corrected later.

inputs.name: Reason
inputs.value: Rule: standard HR request template (parsed with split, Copilot not needed)

Condition_-_standard_template.description: Fast path: templated requests become tickets without spending AI credits.

Stage_1_-_Rules_pre-filter.description: Free, deterministic checks that run before Copilot: auto-replies, system senders, and replies on existing tickets.

Run_a_prompt_-_HR_triage.description: Copilot / AI Builder prompt 'HR Inbox Triage' (see assets/triage-prompt.md). Returns JSON.

Compose_Clean_AI_output.description: Strips Markdown code fences in case the model wraps its JSON.

Set_AI_-_fallback_when_Copilot_fails.description: Fail-safe: if the prompt errors or returns invalid JSON, the email still becomes a ticket (status Needs Triage). Nothing is silently dropped.

Set_Route_-_Copilot.description: ticket = HR must act (or the email is sensitive). noaction = confidently informational. review = unsure, a human glances at it in the Review folder.

inputs.name: Reason
inputs.value: @if(equals(variables('Route'), 'ticket'), concat('Copilot: HR action required - ', coalesce(variables('AI')?['requestedAction'], '')), concat('Copilot: no HR action - ', coalesce(variables('AI')?['nonActionReason'], '')))

Stage_2_-_Copilot_classification.description: Only genuinely new conversations reach the AI prompt.

Compose_Ticket_Fields.description: Validates Copilot output against allowed values - never trust free text from the model.

Compose_Ticket_Routing.description: Assignee from the routing map in settings; SLA due date from priority.

parameters.item/OriginalEmail: @if(outputs('Compose_Ticket_Fields')?['sensitive'], '[Sensitive - open the original email in the HR shared mailbox]', outputs('Compose_Body_Text'))

Filter_file_attachments.description: Skip inline images such as email signatures.

Condition_-_copy_attachments.description: Sensitive tickets never get attachments copied to SharePoint - they stay in the mailbox.

parameters.replyParameters/Body:
Hello,

Thanks for contacting HR. Your request has been logged as ticket @{variables('TicketNumber')} and assigned to the right team member.

Please keep [@{variables('TicketNumber')}] in the subject line if you reply, so your message is added to the same ticket.

Kind regards,
HR Team

Reply_with_ticket_number.description: Requires Send As / Send on Behalf permission on the shared mailbox for the connection account.

Update_existing_ticket.description: Replies never create duplicate tickets. A reply on a Waiting/Resolved ticket flips it to 'Requester Replied'.

Switch_-_Route.description: ignore / noaction / review need no list item - only the folder move and log below.

Move_email_to_triage_folder.description: Leaves the Inbox empty except for mail the flow could not process.

Create_triage_log_entry.description: Audit trail of every decision. HR reviews the HumanVerdict column weekly to tune the prompt and rules.

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
The HR inbox triage flow failed.

Open the failed run

Check the run history; the email (if any) has been left in the shared mailbox Inbox so it can be re-processed or handled manually.

runError.message: HR inbox triage failed - see Try scope

Catch.description: Catch: alerts the HR automation admin with a link to the failed run.
